wikidot5e:spell:web.effectSummary: Fill a 20-foot cube within 60 feet with sticky webs for up to 1 hour. The area is lightly obscured and difficult terrain. If the webs are not anchored between solid masses or laid across a floor, wall, or ceiling, they collapse and the spell ends at the start of your next turn; webs on a flat surface are 5 feet deep. A creature entering the webs or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity save or is restrained while it remains in the webs, and can use an action for a Strength check against your spell save DC to escape. Fire burns away each exposed 5-foot cube in 1 round and deals 2d4 fire damage to creatures starting their turn in that fire.

wikidot5e:spell:weird.effectSummary: Creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered within 120 feet make Wisdom saves. On a failure, a creature is frightened by illusory manifestations of its deepest fears for up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns while frightened, it makes another Wisdom save; on a failure it takes 4d10 psychic damage, and on a success the spell ends for it.

wikidot5e:spell:whirlwind.effectSummary: Create a 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high whirlwind centered on a ground point within 300 feet for up to 1 minute. As an action, move it up to 30 feet along the ground; it sucks up unsecured Medium-or-smaller objects. A creature first entering the whirlwind on a turn, or entered by the whirlwind, makes a Dexterity save for 10d6 bludgeoning damage, half on success. A Large-or-smaller creature that fails also makes a Strength save or is restrained inside. A restrained creature rises 5 feet at the start of each turn, moves with the whirlwind, and falls when the spell ends unless it can remain aloft. As an action it can make a Strength or Dexterity check against your spell save DC to escape; on success it is hurled 3d6×10 feet in a random direction.

wikidot5e:spell:wild-cunning.effectSummary: Choose one nature-aid effect within 120 feet: learn the location of all ground tracks and gain advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to follow them for 1 hour or until you cast the spell again; learn the location of edible forage; learn the location of clean drinking water; learn the location of suitable shelter; have spirits gather firewood and set up a campsite using your supplies; or have spirits instantly break down a campsite, including extinguishing the fire, packing gear, and burying rubbish.

wikidot5e:spell:wind-walk.effectSummary: After a 1-minute casting, you and up to ten willing visible creatures within 30 feet become cloudlike for 8 hours. In cloud form, a creature has a 300-foot flying speed, resistance to damage from nonmagical weapons, and can take only Dash or begin reverting. Reverting to normal takes 1 minute during which the creature is incapacitated and cannot move; returning to cloud form also takes 1 minute. If the spell ends while a creature is flying in cloud form, it descends 60 feet per round for up to 1 minute and lands safely if possible, otherwise it falls the remaining distance.

wikidot5e:spell:wind-wall.effectSummary: Create a continuous wall of strong wind rising from the ground within 120 feet, up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick, for up to 1 minute. Creatures in its area when it appears make Strength saves for 3d8 bludgeoning damage, half on success. The wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases away; blocks Small-or-smaller flying creatures and objects and gaseous-form creatures; throws loose light materials upward; and automatically deflects ordinary arrows, bolts, and similar projectiles aimed through it, though very heavy projectiles are unaffected.

wikidot5e:spell:wish.effectSummary: The basic, risk-free use duplicates any spell of 8th level or lower without needing that spell's requirements or costly components. Alternatively choose one listed effect: create one nonmagical object worth up to 25,000 gp and no more than 300 feet in any dimension; fully heal up to twenty visible creatures and end on them all effects removable by greater restoration; grant up to ten visible creatures resistance to one chosen damage type; grant up to ten visible creatures immunity to one spell or magical effect for 8 hours; or undo one roll made within the last round by forcing a reroll, optionally with advantage or disadvantage, then choose either result. You may ask for a greater unlisted effect, but the DM determines the outcome and it may fail, only partly succeed, or produce unforeseen consequences. Using wish for anything other than duplicating another spell causes stress: until your next long rest, casting any spell deals 1d10 unavoidable necrotic damage per spell level; your Strength becomes 3 if higher for 2d4 days, with each full day of rest reducing remaining recovery by 2 days; and there is a 33% chance you can never cast wish again.

wikidot5e:spell:witch-bolt.effectSummary: Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within 30 feet. On a hit it takes 1d12 lightning damage and, while you maintain concentration up to 1 minute, you can use your action on later turns to deal 1d12 lightning damage automatically. The spell ends if you use your action for anything else, the target moves out of range, or it gains total cover. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d12 to the initial damage only.

wikidot5e:spell:wither-and-bloom.effectSummary: Choose a 10-foot-radius sphere centered within 60 feet. Creatures of your choice there make Constitution saves, taking 2d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success; nonmagical vegetation withers. One creature of your choice in the area may spend and roll one unspent Hit Die and regain HP equal to the roll plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d6 damage and lets the healing target spend one additional Hit Die and add it to the healing roll.

wikidot5e:spell:word-of-radiance.effectSummary: Each creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 radiant damage. Damage becomes 2d6 at character level 5, 3d6 at 11, and 4d6 at 17.
